cases.question: Explain DEMO-10, including its parent, acceptance criteria and attachments.
cases.reference: DEMO-10, Validate API pagination parameters, is a To Do Story assigned to Blake Demo, reported by Robin Demo, High priority and estimated at 1 point. It belongs to Iteration 1 and its parent is DEMO-2, Backend delivery improvements. It validates backend API pagination parameters for reliability, observable behavior and compatibility with the existing service contract. Acceptance criteria cover normal and empty inputs, clear failure messages with consistent state, checks passing and documentation. Its comment records review of the backend approach using synthetic fixtures. No attachment references or explicit related-issue links are exported for this ticket. Attachment contents cannot be inspected.
